text:
jon: Heads-up — after yesterday's proxy throttle smoothing rollout we're seeing reconnect storms from a subset of tenants. Console shows a big spike in resume_failed and a correlated rise in resume_retries_total.

alex: Which region/route? any tenant pattern?

maria: Traces point to clients getting a 204 from the proxy, then hammering reconnects. Looks concentrated in eu-west and a handful of high-concurrency tenants.

jon: Also noticed sampling on the dashboard is low for these events, so the alert was noisy and missed the root surge.

deploy-bot: deploy @eng-platform: rollout/proxy-throttle-smoothing completed to prod at 11:57 UTC :white_check_mark:

carla: We changed the backoff jitter to be deterministic for smoother quotas (reduced jitter to 0.0) — that could cause client-side sync, leading to simultaneous retries.

alex: Yikes — deterministic jitter + rate limit bursts = thundering herd. We should re-enable randomized jitter. Even 30-50% should break sync.

jon: Quick repro locally — config snippet I used: ```json
{"backoff": {"base_ms": 100, "factor": 2, "jitter": 0.0}}
```

maria: If we re-enable jitter, we should also surface per-tenant retry-rate and resume_attempt latency histograms in the console. Right now it's aggregated and buries the hot tenants.

carla: I'll open a PR to flip jitter back to 0.5 and add the dashboard panels (per-tenant retry_rate, resume_attempts, pause_window_ms histogram). Propose canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m soak.

jon: Sounds good. I'll coordinate an emergency canary. Can we also add a sampling tweak so the console picks up these events faster? Maybe temporarily increase sample fraction for resume_failures for 1h.

sre-oncall: FYI oncall saw the spike at 12:03 UTC; alert noise got bad. I silenced the paging but left channel alerts. Will watch.

alex: Also tiny API/metrics ask: rename metric labels to avoid confusion — we currently have resume_retries_total and resume_attempts (seem overlapping). Can we make it explicit: resume_client_retries vs resume_server_rate_limited?

maria: +1 on clarity. That will make dashboard filters much easier.

carla: PR: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/4823 — flips jitter to 0.5 and adds metrics hooks. Adding dashboard change in a follow-up.

jon: I'll start canary deploy now on a small route and bump sampling. Reporting back in ~15m.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started (route: eu-west-1, 5%) — monitor: console/streaming/route-eu-west1-canary

jon: After 12m the retry storm dropped on the canary route. Looks promising. I'll keep it at 5% for 30m then scale.

alex: Great. After we finish rollout, let's add a small doc in eng-platform on safe-backoff-defaults and console panels to avoid future silent regressions.

maria: Agreed — also add a short note for SRE runbook: temporary sampling increase when resume_failures spike.

sre-oncall: Thanks — I'll update the runbook entry after rollout completes.

jon: TL;DR: root cause = jitter=0 deterministic smoothing + quotas -> synchronized retries. Fix = re-enable jitter + improved per-tenant telemetry + controlled canary. Thanks all :thumbsup:
